name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)

entry.cost: Exam and course fees (listed on page)
entry.name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)
entry.note: The Project Management Institute credential for running AI projects
entry.audience: Project, program and product managers leading AI initiatives

reading.format: A 21 hour exam prep course provides knowledge and skills to pass the exam and manage AI projects effectively.
reading.summary: This certification is for managing AI projects. It gives tools and strategies to lead AI initiatives and turn innovation into measurable value. Holding it shows structured, responsible practice in AI project management.
reading.audience: It is for project managers, technologists, data experts, and consultants. It suits people already delivering AI initiatives or those who want to start.
